metadata.description:
Did you know that 1.5 billion people live in China, the country in Asia where Mandarin comes from? That’s a lot of people! 

Interested in learning this fascinating language? Here’s a great place to start! Join Sophie and Elim in this fun and interactive card as they teach you 100 commonly-used words in Mandarin… from 你好 nǐ hǎo to 再见 zàijiàn!
